name: Deep Strike
strategy: Deploy reserve formations into unexpected battlefield positions, launch flanking attacks, and establish forward landing zones.
designNote: Deep Strike changes where ordinary reinforcements may arrive. It does not create an additional Reserve pool or raise the universal reinforcement allowance.

deepStrikeReserve.rule: All Units designated as Reserve under the universal Staggered Deployment rules form one shared Reserve pool. An army with Deep Strike does not designate a second or separate Deep Strike Reserve. Any eligible Unit in that pool may enter normally or through an appropriate Deep Strike Command.
theseUnits: Count toward the universal mandatory Reserve Unit count, not a separate Reserve Point Value limit.
Are included in the army’s normal Points, Recruitment Slot, and composition limits.
Begin the battle off the battlefield.
Cannot perform actions or use abilities while in Reserve unless explicitly permitted.
May enter normally beginning in Round 1, or through a selected Deep Strike Command beginning in Round 2.
A Deep Strike arrival counts against that Round’s normal reinforcement allowance unless a rule expressly says otherwise.
additionalRules: Half of the army’s purchased Units, rounded up, must begin in Reserve under universal Staggered Deployment rules; if the army includes a Headquarters Unit, at least one must deploy normally.
Large Assets may arrive as ordinary Reserves, but may arrive using Deep Strike deployment only through Heavy Descent or another ability expressly permitting it.

procedure: During a friendly Movement activation in Round 2 or later, spend CP/exhaust the card for one eligible insertion Command and designate one Reserve Unit.
Consume one slot from the current Round shared reinforcement allowance. Only one Unit may be designated via Deep Strike in a Round.
Place designated Deep Strike Units after Scoring during the End Step, alternating sides beginning with the first Movement activator.
The Unit cannot act or score during the Round it arrives, but may act normally from the next Round.
defaultPlacementRequirements: Wholly more than 8" from every enemy Model.
In legal positions with normal Unit coherency.
arrivingFromDeepStrikeReserve.note: Deep Strike begins in Round 2 and resolves in the End Step after Scoring; default exclusion more than 8 inches.

unitArrivingThroughDeepStrike: Arrives during End Step after Scoring and cannot act, attack, charge, React, or score in its arrival Round.
Can act normally the following Round; Heavy uses the next Movement Phase as usual.
Landing Fire and Heavy Descent apply in the following Round only.
additionalRules: Only one Unit may arrive through an insertion Command per Round; ordinary Reserves consume any other available arrival slots.
If no legal placement exists at the End Step, the Unit remains in Reserve; CP/card are not refunded.
Signal Beacon must be used in a different friendly Movement activation from the insertion Command.

commands.name: Forward Insertion
commands.effect: Designate one eligible Reserve Unit for End Step insertion after scoring using normal Deep Strike restrictions (more than 8 inches from enemies, outside enemy Deployment Zone), counting toward normal reinforcement allowance.

commands.name: Landing Fire
commands.effect: If the active Unit arrived through Deep Strike at the end of the previous Round, it gains Accurate 2 and Pinpoint on its next ranged Attack this Assault Phase. Heavy restrictions still apply.

commands.name: Flanking Insertion
commands.effect: Designate one eligible Reserve Unit for End Step placement within 3 inches of a battlefield edge and more than 6 inches from enemies. May enter the enemy Deployment Zone; other requirements apply.

commands.name: Heavy Descent
commands.effect: Designate one eligible Reserve Unit, including a Large Asset, for End Step placement with normal Deep Strike restrictions (more than 8 inches from enemies). Gain Tough 2 against the first Attack suffered in the following Round, then expire.

commands.name: Signal Beacon
commands.effect: Designate the active friendly Unit, which must already be on the battlefield, as a beacon until this Round’s insertion step. A separately designated Deep Strike Unit placed wholly within Short of this beacon may use a more-than-6" enemy exclusion distance instead of 8". Its insertion Command must be used during a different friendly Movement activation; Signal Beacon itself does not insert a Unit.

commandClarifications.clarification: Provides basic forward deployment, allowing a Unit to bypass the distance and terrain between the player’s deployment zone and a legal insertion point.
Usable in the following Round, not the insertion Round, and does not waive Heavy.
Provides alternate access to battlefield edges, including enemy deployment territory, subject to its more-than-6" exclusion distance.
Allows Large Asset insertion. Temporary Tough 2 protects against the first Attack of the following Round.
Use in a different earlier Movement activation from the insertion Command; benefit lasts through End Step. Does not create another arrival.

doctrineIdentity: Delayed End Step insertion, giving up immediate shooting and scoring for superior next-Round positioning.

distinctionFromOtherDoctrines.distinction: Improves the movement of Units already on the battlefield.
Uses friendly Units to create additional movement opportunities.
Maximizes early-Round offense and can bring in one extra Round 1 reinforcement.
Changes where purchased Reserve Units enter the battle, within the normal arrival allowance.
